facts.value: DNU-1541: unison-feed lockstitch, 2,500 spm, no safety mechanism, no trimmer; DNU-1541S: same plus a safety mechanism; DNU-1541-7: 3,000 spm with automatic trimmer
facts.note: The S suffix is the safety mechanism only. Model name is not a spec (rule 9).
